way_beyond.title: The Way Beyond
way_beyond.description: The ancient archway opens before you. The forest recognizes your wisdom and allows you to escape. You leave Eldergrove carrying the memories of your journey.

forest_keeper.title: The Forest's Keeper
forest_keeper.description: The ancient roots awaken beneath your feet. Eldergrove chooses you as its new guardian. You remain in the forest, protecting its secrets for generations to come.

golden_awakening.title: The Golden Awakening
golden_awakening.description: A golden light rises from the forgotten ruins. Your courage awakens an ancient power, restoring life and hope to Eldergrove. The forest will remember you as its savior.

eternal_wanderer.title: The Eternal Wanderer
eternal_wanderer.description: The paths twist and disappear behind you. Unable to find the way out, you wander through Eldergrove forever, following whispers that never lead home.

forgotten_soul.title: The Forgotten Soul
forgotten_soul.description: A cold mist surrounds you. Slowly, your memories fade, until even your own name is forgotten. Eldergrove keeps your story, but the world never hears it.

roots_of_eternity.title: The Roots of Eternity
roots_of_eternity.description: Ancient roots rise from beneath the earth and surround you. The forest claims your spirit, binding you to its forgotten depths for all eternity.
